lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a grid-like configuration with the highest-intensity maxima located along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a series of anchor nodes across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and distinct shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 distinct high-luminance spots is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located on the lower half and leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch or loss of pixel continuity is visible at the apex of the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the larger blobs on the primary flank.
